title: RelationAuditTrail
description: A consolidated audit view of one relation: identity and qualifiers, review status, evidence records with anchors, source-state resolutions, admissibility results, provenance activities, and review events. When queried with a profile and time, it MAY include the evidential state snapshot at that time.

evidence.description: All evidence records bearing on the relation.

sourceStateResolutions.description: Source states resolved for the relation's evidence anchors (via the profile's owner function).

admissibilityResults.description: Admissibility results relevant to the audited time (when a profile/time was supplied).

provenanceActivities.description: Provenance activities across the relation and its evidence.

reviewEvents.description: Review events across the relation and its evidence.

evidentialState.description: Optional computed evidential state at the audited time.
